LSE 0.6.1: faster short-prompt prefill, faster draft-tree verification, and a fix for FlashPrefill V2 dropping facts from long prompts.

- macOS: needs mac_linuxgpu build 267 or later; the archive bundles the HSA runtime.
- Linux: needs the amdgpu kernel driver with KFD and access to `/dev/kfd`; the archive bundles the HSA runtime.

## Performance

Prefill, tok/s (prompt tokens / time to first token, measured by the client on a new prompt length):

| GPU | OS | 256 | 1K | 2K | 4K | 32K |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Radeon 8060S (gfx1151) | Linux | 460 | 501 | 526 | 538 | 480 |
| Radeon AI PRO R9700 | iPadOS (LemonSeed Studio) | Results pending | | | | |
| Radeon AI PRO R9700 | Linux | 1,247 | 1,396 | 1,457 | 1,484 | 1,388 |
| Radeon AI PRO R9700 | macOS | Results pending | | | | |

Decode, code prompt, tok/s:

| GPU | OS | Baseline | dMTP | DFlash2 |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Radeon 8060S (gfx1151) | Linux | 14.1 | 47.0 | **65.2** |
| Radeon AI PRO R9700 | iPadOS (LemonSeed Studio) | Results pending | | |
| Radeon AI PRO R9700 | Linux | 32.3 | 108.9 | **152.8** |
| Radeon AI PRO R9700 | macOS | Results pending | | |

Model: Qwen3.8-27B, 4-bit (MLX); drafts: dMTP (dynamic MTP) 8-bit, DFlash2 8-bit. Temperature 0.6, median of 3, after a warm-up that completes kernel variant selection. Prefill is now measured as time to first token on a new prompt length, so it is not comparable with the 0.6.0 table.

## Changes

- FlashPrefill V2 reads the whole prompt exactly for its final rows, so a short fact anywhere in a long prompt is no longer dropped from the answer (needle retrieval at 32K and 128K: 6 of 6, was 4 of 6), with no change in prefill time.
- Prefill GEMM tiles chosen per pass width on gfx1201 and gfx1151: up to 17% less time to first token on the R9700 and 19% on the gfx1151 at widths just past a tile multiple. dMTP prefill takes the single padded pass the other modes use (31–52% faster at 256–512 tokens).
- Draft-tree verification: 15- and 31-row tree passes take about half the time on the R9700, with byte-identical output.
- Adaptive draft width: the first request after a warm-up or a context change runs at the steady-state step count.
- Kernel variant choices are kept per shape class beside the kernel cache, so later starts skip the trials.
- dMTP at long context on the gfx1151: 30.3 tok/s at 128K and 21.4 at 256K (0.6.0: 25.6 and 18.3).
